title: Ghost Portal Cartographer: Evidence-Tiered Mapping of Indirect Sensitive-Data Egress
description: A metadata-only reference kernel and research paper for evidence-tiered analysis of indirect sensitive-data routes through logs, telemetry, memory artifacts, caches and integrations. Three nested evidence relations are searched under independent budgets; a returned witness is labeled by the strongest relation it satisfies; trace parentage is diagnostic only; and authenticated transformation claims never suppress a route. Includes the paper, LaTeX source, standard-library Python kernel, 171 tests, two separately coded oracles, eleven deliberate mutants, synthetic fixtures and a checksum manifest. Synthetic evaluation only; not a production DLP or detection system.
